description: A painted living room scene with a worn plaid-cushioned couch, a brick-style mobile phone and a corded handset on the cushions, and a rumpled blanket. A CRT television on the right shows an American football game. A brown beer bottle, a glass and a bowl of snacks sit on a side table, with tangled cords on the floor. The style is dark oil-painting realism, with no people in view.
